title: Mars
subtitle: What would kill you first?

description:
Episode 3 of a daily journey through the universe. 🔴
We land on Mars: why it's red, what would kill you first without a suit, the tallest volcano in the solar system, and why sunsets there are blue.

🪐 Tomorrow, Episode 4: Next stop, Jupiter. More than a thousand Earths could fit inside it.
Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

Images: NASA (public domain)
Narration: AI voice

#space #mars #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Even at its closest, Mars is more than fifty million kilometers away. The trip takes about seven months.
segments.headline: ~7 months to get there

segments.text: Welcome to the red planet. Its color comes from rust. Iron in the dust.
segments.headline: The red is rust

segments.text: So what would kill you first? Not the cold. Not the radiation. The air.
segments.headline: What kills you first?

segments.text: It's almost all carbon dioxide, and less than one percent as thick as Earth's. Without a suit, you'd pass out in about fifteen seconds.

visual.label: until you pass out
visual.sub: Air: less than 1% as thick as Earth's

segments.text: Survive that, and the cold is next. The average temperature is around minus sixty degrees Celsius.
But Mars has wonders too. Olympus Mons, the tallest volcano in the solar system, is about two and a half times taller than Everest.
segments.headline: 2.5× taller than Everest
